numinance.kinds.v1.LanguageToolchainSpec.description: LanguageToolchainSpec names a language version and its tools.

formatters.description:
formatters names the formatters; a narrower scope adds to the wider scope's list. Each name resolves to a declared
 provider with a lockfile entry; a name is never executed as a command.

language.description: language is required and matches ^[0-9A-Za-z.+-]{1,64}$ (the profile context enforces it).

package_manager.description: package_manager is the package manager the toolchain uses: a name that resolves to a declared provider, never a command.

verifiers.description: verifiers is required and non-empty; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

version.description: version is required: the language version, matching ^[0-9A-Za-z.+-]{1,64}$; toolchain artifacts are pinned by digest in the lockfile, never by this string.

numinance.kinds.v1.LanguageToolchainSpec.title: Language Toolchain Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.ToolchainVerifier.jso.description: ToolchainVerifier is one deterministic verifier of the toolchain.

config.description: config is passed to the verifier as is; the Engine never reads it.

name.description: name is required and unique in the toolchain; playbook steps and pack checks reference it.

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of a verifier port provider, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

numinance.kinds.v1.ToolchainVerifier.jso.title: Toolchain Verifier
